content: Autonomous E2E QA product landscape: Octomind (agent explores app, generates Playwright, octomind pull syncs healed tests, self-healing stated as lifecycle problem not solved); mabl (agentic auto-heal, GenAI test creation); KaneAI (NL plan-author-evolve); BrowserStack AI (PRD/user-story to test cases, 20+ agents, self-heal, observability); Wopee (bot explores, Playwright gen, self-heal, GitHub Action + MCP); testRigor/QA.tech (goal-driven UI agents, no selectors).
